purpose: Offline answerability gates on fixed E5-small text vectors; production remains blocked until separate promotion approval.

feature_definitions.vector_top1: Highest vector cosine; missing scores padded with 0; no chunks hard-block answerability.
feature_definitions.margin_1_2: max(0, highest vector cosine - second vector cosine padded with 0).
feature_definitions.lexical_top1: Highest strictly positive ts_rank_cd from existing spanish FTS; 0 when absent.
feature_definitions.vector_lexical_agreement: Cardinality(intersection(top3 vector chunk IDs, top3 strictly-positive lexical chunk IDs)) / 3.
feature_definitions.exact_taxonomy_name_match: 1 iff normalized query contains a curated complete taxonomy name/alias using whole-token boundaries; otherwise 0.
feature_definitions.normalized_keyword_overlap: Cardinality(unique useful normalized query tokens intersect union useful tokens of vector-top3 search_text) / cardinality(unique useful query tokens); empty query-token denominator yields 0.

normalization_authority: PHP: Str::ascii -> mb_lower -> non-L/non-N to spaces -> whitespace collapse. Python uses exported scalars and does not re-normalize query text.

retrieval_context.vector_context: Final answer context is unmodified vector Top3 with deterministic chunk-ID tie break.
retrieval_context.lexical_role: Gate features only; does not reorder vector context or alter V1 RRF.

multi_signal.expression: vector_top1 >= vector_min AND (exact_taxonomy_name_match == 1 OR (lexical_top1 > lexical_min AND normalized_keyword_overlap >= overlap_min AND vector_lexical_agreement >= agreement_min))
multi_signal.score: binary rule result (0 or 1); AUROC/PR-AUC are coarse binary-score diagnostics

logistic_regression.calibration: none; sigmoid output is not calibrated factual certainty
logistic_regression.portable_format: JSON scaler means/scales, coefficients, intercept; no pickle

routing.algorithm: Frozen deterministic three-class safety/ambiguity router, no ML.

gates.critical_camisa_blusa: Accepted answerable; vector Top3 contains comparison, CAMISAS and BLUSAS (3/3).
gates.accepted_positive_recall_at_3_definition: Query-level HitRecall@3: at least one independently-authored alternative supporting document in vector Top3.

recall_at_3.primary_definition: Count of accepted true-positive queries with at least one expected alternative supporting document in vector Top3 / count of accepted true-positive queries.
recall_at_3.diagnostic_definition: Mean across accepted true-positive queries of intersection(expected_document_ids,vector_top3_document_ids) count / expected_document_ids count.
recall_at_3.ground_truth_note: Independent author froze multiple expected IDs as ALTERNATIVE sufficient supporting sources. Distinction fixed before feature extraction or measurement; V1 fractional Recall@3 is not directly comparable to V2 primary query-hit recall.
recall_at_3.expected_ids: Supporting document alternatives fixed by independent author before retrieval; never altered based on retrieval.
recall_at_3.unaccepted_positive_policy: Report binary false-reject count; do not silently remove from positive recall denominator.

selection.diagnostic_when_no_cal_pass: Prefer recall>=.90 candidates by FAR ascending, recall descending, F1 descending; if none has recall>=.90 use F1 descending, recall descending, FAR ascending; deterministic threshold and candidate-ID ties.
selection.holdout_candidates: Three representatives sealed using CAL only; one final joint evaluation.
selection.none_cal_eligible: Diagnostic holdout only; NO_PROMOTION even if a representative passes holdout.

statistics.binomial_ci: Wilson, report counts/denominators for accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, FAR, FRR.
statistics.f1_mcc_auc_ci: No Wilson applied to non-binomial F1/MCC/AUC; point estimates with explicit denominators.
statistics.fractional_recall_at_3_ci: Primary query-hit recall is binomial Wilson; diagnostic fractional expected-document recall has no binomial Wilson, report sum/query count.
statistics.undefined: null with denominator 0; never substitute success

holdout_controls.start_marker: Exclusive O_CREAT|O_EXCL, fsync before opening holdout; persists on failures.
holdout_controls.failure_policy: NO_PROMOTION; no deletion/retry/reset of start marker.
